title: Unconditional Characteristic-2 Two-Layer Recovery, Even-q Double-Projective-Simplex Batch Codes, and Deterministic Polynomial-Time Locality-2 Recovery
abstract: Advancing Essayag and Zabokritskiy (arXiv:2611.34382v1) and Kiliç-Ravagnani-Salizzoni (Open Problem 3.13), we prove four new constructive theorems on functional batch codes over even-characteristic finite fields F_q (q = 2^m >= 4): (1) an Unconditional Characteristic-2 Two-Layer Theorem proving that any two distinct layers H_alpha u H_beta (2h servers, h = q^(s-1)) constructively serve every list of h requests outside H with arbitrary sum (zero or nonzero) with locality 2 in deterministic O(h^2) time via M. Hall and characteristic-2 translation invariance; (2) an Even-q Double-Projective-Simplex Theorem proving that the fixed length-2N code 2*P_{q,s} serves every balanced-flag (N+1)-list in arbitrary dimension s >= 3 and every hyperplane-concentrated (N+1)-list unconditionally in dimension s = 3 (via coloop-free q^2-sublist extraction and projective scalar balancing); (3) a Deterministic Polynomial-Time Recovery Theorem avoiding the non-constructive Balister-Gyori-Schelp Pfaffian oracle across two-layer h-lists, balanced-flag and hyperplane-concentrated (N+1)-lists, all s=2 lists, and affine-split full-T_{4,s} hyperplane-avoiding lists; and (4) Exact Dimension-2 Constructive Capacities t_max(P_{q,2}) = floor((q+2)/2) and t_max(2*P_{q,2}) = q+2 for all prime powers q >= 2. Formalized with 20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems (0 sorry, 0 grind, 0 Classical.choice, 0 custom axioms), AST-pure zero-float verifier, 16 SHA-256 certificates, and 69 passing tests.
